## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the problem, the final change, and why it helps.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results, or explain what was not tested. Documentation-only changes do not need a full application test run. Do not incur model charges for unrelated validation.

## Data and compatibility

Describe any effect on saved data, source references, user edits, dependencies, or deployment. Include migration or recovery notes if relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I included no private Vault, conversations, knowledge/skills/concepts, credentials, runtime configuration, or unredacted logs.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the MIT License and preserved third-party notices.
- [ ] I documented relevant user-visible changes and validation limits.
